output.summary: The 98.1% on-time figure appears to be produced by moving promised dates, not by better delivery. Revisions rose 5x. Each center's jump coincides with its bonus start: Northgate and Riverside in March, Pell Junction in July. RouteWise went live in February and Northgate's on-time rate stayed at 91% through Feb, so RouteWise does not explain the jump. Revisions are now mostly capacity-coded, late-entered and rarely customer-notified. Customer-requested revisions per 100 shipments are flat. Brightwell's receiving log shows 81% on time against the booked date, down from 87%, versus the 98.4% scorecard. Dispatchers report pressure to protect the number. The campaign and a higher bonus are harmful. Recomputing against original dates and re-basing the incentive are preferred. The driver-shortage claim is unestablished, and the $2.1M hiring plan is premature.
